2760-4279-6094.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-6094.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-6094.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2131-4574-4779-6900--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2131-4574-4779-6900--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

483-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

529-1753-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

997-4082-4640--201.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2685-3263-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3263-5641-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1902-4742.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-4742.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2486-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

5641-6720-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6720-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-6094.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

460-539-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
460-539-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1462-2034-2534-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Coercive Recruiter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2961-6553-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

560-2558-5315-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-3062-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Pir.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-3062-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

252-2921-5394.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1495-4120-6260.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-6260.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-6260.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

3528-3976-5636.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3528-3976-5636.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
3528-3976-5636.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

2719-3698-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2719-3698-5365.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.
2719-3698-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

222-527-1753-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1753-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

618-2034-3742.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-3641-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3641-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

914-1075-2068-2438.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1075-2068-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Carrion Feeder's ability.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Bonecaller Cleric by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing it, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bonecaller Cleric's ability, with the copy targeting Bonecaller Cleric.
Resolve both Bonecaller Cleric abilities, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

914-1368-3698-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard if Dockside Extortionist is in your graveyard.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1368-3698-5147.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist either from your hand by paying {1}{R} or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
The Treasures enter the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station that many times, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing a Treasure, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

413-864-3518-3637.description:
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Blasting Station.
In response, activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Eternal Witness, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Brought Back from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brought Back by paying {W}{W}, returning Eternal Witness and Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2, adding mana of any color in step 3 once you have an arbitrary amount of white mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may choose any other valid target for Brought Back in place of Lion's Eye Diamond in step 7.
